title: Lamb Tagine with Crispy Crunch
description: A classic Moroccan dish made with tender lamb, crunchy nuts, and a blend of spices. Serve with couscous or bread for a hearty meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cumin, tagine spice blend, and salt. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Transfer to the oven and braise for 2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Meanwhile, toast almonds in a small pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
To serve, divide lamb among bowls and top with toasted almonds and a side of couscous.
